verses.original: כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ שָׂרְפ֛וֹ לַשִּֽׂיד׃ עַצְמ֥וֹת אֱד֖וֹם מֶֽלֶךְ־
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar ‘al- šə·lō·šāh piš·‘ê mō·w·’āḇ wə·‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ‘al- śā·rə·p̄ōw laś·śîḏ ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm me·leḵ-
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says For three transgressions of Moab even four I will not revoke [My judgment] because he burned to lime the bones of Edom’s king

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ אֵ֣שׁ בְּמוֹאָ֔ב וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֣וֹת הַקְּרִיּ֑וֹת מוֹאָ֔ב וּמֵ֤ת בְּשָׁאוֹן֙ בִּתְרוּעָ֖ה בְּק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šil·laḥ·tî- ’êš bə·mō·w·’āḇ wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh ’ar·mə·nō·wṯ haq·qə·rî·yō·wṯ mō·w·’āḇ ū·mêṯ bə·šā·’ō·wn biṯ·rū·‘āh bə·qō·wl šō·w·p̄ār
verses.literal: So I will send fire against Moab to consume the citadels of Kerioth Moab will die in tumult amid war cries and the sound of the ram’s horn

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י שׁוֹפֵ֖ט מִקִּרְבָּ֑הּ אֶהֱר֥וֹג וְכָל־ שָׂרֶ֛יהָ עִמּ֖וֹ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḵ·rat·tî šō·w·p̄êṭ miq·qir·bāh ’e·hĕ·rō·wḡ wə·ḵāl śā·re·hā ‘im·mōw ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will cut off the ruler of [Moab] and kill all the officials with him says the LORD

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַֽל־ מָאֳסָ֞ם אֶת־ תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֣א שָׁמָ֔רוּ וְחֻקָּיו֙ וַיַּתְעוּם֙ כִּזְבֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ אֲבוֹתָ֖ם הָלְכ֥וּ אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar ‘al- šə·lō·šāh piš·‘ê yə·hū·ḏāh wə·‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ‘al- mā·’o·sām ’eṯ- tō·w·raṯ Yah·weh lō šā·mā·rū wə·ḥuq·qāw way·yaṯ·‘ūm kiz·ḇê·hem ’ă·šer- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām hā·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rê·hem
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says For three transgressions of Judah even four I will not revoke [My judgment] because they reject - the Law of the LORD and fail to keep His statutes they are led astray by the lies in which their fathers walked . . .

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ
verses.literal: So I will send fire upon Judah to consume the citadels of Jerusalem

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ מִכְרָ֤ם צַדִּ֔יק בַּכֶּ֙סֶף֙ וְאֶבְי֖וֹן בַּעֲב֥וּר נַעֲלָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar ‘al- šə·lō·šāh piš·‘ê yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ‘al- miḵ·rām ṣad·dîq bak·ke·sep̄ wə·’eḇ·yō·wn ba·‘ă·ḇūr na·‘ă·lā·yim
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says For three transgressions of Israel even four I will not revoke [My judgment] because they sell the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals

verses.original: הַשֹּׁאֲפִ֤ים בְּרֹ֣אשׁ דַּלִּ֔ים עַל־ עֲפַר־ אֶ֙רֶץ֙ יַטּ֑וּ עֲנָוִ֖ים וְדֶ֥רֶךְ וְאִ֣ישׁ וְאָבִ֗יו יֵֽלְכוּ֙ אֶל־ הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ה לְמַ֥עַן חַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־ קָדְשִֽׁי׃ שֵׁ֥ם
verses.transliteration: haš·šō·’ă·p̄îm bə·rōš dal·lîm ‘al- ‘ă·p̄ar- ’e·reṣ yaṭ·ṭū ‘ă·nā·wîm wə·ḏe·reḵ wə·’îš wə·’ā·ḇîw yê·lə·ḵū ’el- han·na·‘ă·rāh lə·ma·‘an ḥal·lêl ’eṯ- qāḏ·šî šêm
verses.literal: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the earth they push the needy out of their way A man and his father have relations with . . . the same girl and so profane - My holy name

verses.original: יַטּ֔וּ אֵ֖צֶל כָּל־ מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעַל־ בְּגָדִ֤ים חֲבֻלִים֙ בֵּ֖ית אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃ יִשְׁתּ֔וּ וְיֵ֤ין עֲנוּשִׁים֙
verses.transliteration: yaṭ·ṭū ’ê·ṣel kāl- miz·bê·aḥ wə·‘al- bə·ḡā·ḏîm ḥă·ḇu·lîm bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem yiš·tū wə·yên ‘ă·nū·šîm
verses.literal: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge And in the house of their God they drink wine obtained through fines

verses.original: וְאָ֨נֹכִ֜י הִשְׁמַ֤דְתִּי אֶת־ הָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר כְּגֹ֤בַהּ גָּבְה֔וֹ אֲרָזִים֙ ה֖וּא וְחָסֹ֥ן כָּֽאַלּוֹנִ֑ים וָאַשְׁמִ֤יד פִּרְיוֹ֙ מִמַּ֔עַל וְשָׁרָשָׁ֖יו מִתָּֽחַת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî hiš·maḏ·tî ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî mip·pə·nê·hem ’ă·šer kə·ḡō·ḇah gā·ḇə·hōw ’ă·rā·zîm hū wə·ḥā·sōn kā·’al·lō·w·nîm wā·’aš·mîḏ pir·yōw mim·ma·‘al wə·šā·rā·šāw mit·tā·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: Yet [it was] I who destroyed - the Amorite before them though his height was like that of the cedars and he was as strong as the oaks Yet I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֛י הֶעֱלֵ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וָאוֹלֵ֨ךְ אֶתְכֶ֤ם אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ הָאֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî he·‘ĕ·lê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wā·’ō·w·lêḵ ’eṯ·ḵem ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh bam·miḏ·bār lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî
verses.literal: And I brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness that you might take possession - of the land of the Amorite

verses.original: וָאָקִ֤ים לִנְבִיאִ֔ים מִבְּנֵיכֶם֙ לִנְזִרִ֑ים וּמִבַּחוּרֵיכֶ֖ם זֹ֛את אֵֽין־ הַאַ֥ף בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·qîm lin·ḇî·’îm mib·bə·nê·ḵem lin·zi·rîm ū·mib·ba·ḥū·rê·ḵem zōṯ ’ên- ha·’ap̄ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I raised up prophets from your sons and Nazirites from your young men Is this not true O children of Israel declares the LORD

verses.original: הַנְּזִרִ֖ים וַתַּשְׁק֥וּ אֶת־ יָ֑יִן וְעַל־ צִוִּיתֶ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר הַנְּבִיאִים֙ לֹ֖א תִּנָּבְאֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: han·nə·zi·rîm wat·taš·qū ’eṯ- yā·yin wə·‘al- ṣiw·wî·ṯem lê·mōr han·nə·ḇî·’îm lō tin·nā·ḇə·’ū
verses.literal: But you made the Nazirites drink - wine . . . and commanded . . . the prophets not to prophesy

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י מֵעִ֖יק תַּחְתֵּיכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר תָּעִיק֙ הָעֲגָלָ֔ה הַֽמְלֵאָ֥ה לָ֖הּ עָמִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·‘îq taḥ·tê·ḵem ka·’ă·šer tā·‘îq hā·‘ă·ḡā·lāh ham·lê·’āh lāh ‘ā·mîr
verses.literal: Behold I am about to crush you in your place as [with] a cart full of grain

verses.original: מָנוֹס֙ וְאָבַ֤ד מִקָּ֔ל וְחָזָ֖ק לֹא־ יְאַמֵּ֣ץ כֹּח֑וֹ וְגִבּ֖וֹר לֹא־ יְמַלֵּ֥ט נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mā·nō·ws wə·’ā·ḇaḏ miq·qāl wə·ḥā·zāq lō- yə·’am·mêṣ kō·ḥōw wə·ḡib·bō·wr lō- yə·mal·lêṭ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: Escape will fail the swift the strong will not prevail by his strength and the mighty will not save his life

verses.original: וְתֹפֵ֤שׂ הַקֶּ֙שֶׁת֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔ד וְקַ֥ל בְּרַגְלָ֖יו לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּ֑ט וְרֹכֵ֣ב הַסּ֔וּס לֹ֥א יְמַלֵּ֖ט נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯō·p̄êś haq·qe·šeṯ lō ya·‘ă·mōḏ wə·qal bə·raḡ·lāw lō yə·mal·lêṭ wə·rō·ḵêḇ has·sūs lō yə·mal·lêṭ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: The archer . . . will not stand his ground the fleet of foot will not escape and the horseman . . . will not save his life

verses.original: וְאַמִּ֥יץ בַּגִּבּוֹרִ֑ים לִבּ֖וֹ יָנ֥וּס עָר֛וֹם הַה֖וּא בַּיּוֹם־ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’am·mîṣ bag·gib·bō·w·rîm lib·bōw yā·nūs ‘ā·rō·wm ha·hū bay·yō·wm- nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Even the bravest of mighty men will flee naked on that day declares the LORD
